newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss banks - no comment on Bayernwerk.
newsitem.headline: Swiss banks - no comment on Bayernwerk.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) declined comment on a statement by German electricty company Bayernwerk AG that it was interested in a Swiss utility controlled by a firm largely held by UBS.
CS Holding also declined to comment on Bayernwerk's interest in its 44.9 percent stake in electricity and building controls company Elektrowatt.

Bayernwerk said earlier it was in talks with UBS on buying part of the bank's 76 percent share in energy holding Motor-Columbus AG, whose main asset is a 56 percent stake in utility Aare-Tessin AG fuer Elektrizitaet (Atel).
A UBS spokesman declined to comment except to say the bank has long stated it wanted to sell the holding in Motor-Colombus because the industrial group does not fit its core activities.
"We will inform the public at that time (when Motor-Columbus is sold), the spokesman said.
At CS Holding, whose flagship bank is Credit Suisse, a spokesman also declined to comment on the statement by Bayernwerk management board member Otto Majewski.
Majewski said Bayernwerk was interested in just the electrical power activities at Elektrowatt.
CS Holding has been looking to sell its stake in Elektrowatt to offset provisions for a massive restructuring programme launched in July, but has also said it would wait for the proper price.
